description:
Perform a Structured Data audit on https://books.toscrape.com/ using Screaming Frog SEO Spider. 

STEPS:
1. Configure the Spider to extract Structured Data (JSON-LD, Microdata, RDFa) in Configuration > Spider > Extraction.
2. Crawl the website https://books.toscrape.com/.
3. After the crawl completes (allow it to find at least 50 pages), export the Structured Data findings to a CSV file in ~/Documents/SEO/exports/.
4. Also export the standard Internal HTML report to a CSV file in ~/Documents/SEO/exports/.
5. Write a text report at ~/Documents/SEO/reports/structured_data_audit.txt analyzing the findings. The report must include: the total number of pages crawled, how many pages have structured data vs. missing data, which Schema types are present (or missing), and specific recommendations for implementation (e.g., Product schema).

SUCCESS CRITERIA:
- Two CSV files exist in ~/Documents/SEO/exports/ (one for structured data, one for internal HTML).
- The files contain data from books.toscrape.com.
- A text report exists at ~/Documents/SEO/reports/structured_data_audit.txt with analysis and recommendations.
